item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Gate creation and opening separately","mechanism":"Creation requires rollout permission and format-writing capability; opening depends on stored format and reading capability, not the flag.","implementation":"Persist each document's format version. Authorize requests normally, then check the requesting client's declared capabilities before returning content or accepting creation.","check":"Exercise flag-on/off against old/new clients and old/new documents. Unsupported opens return an explicit error, never unparseable document bytes.","risk":"Declared capabilities can be stale or inaccurate."},{"action":"Preserve existing documents when adopting the new format","mechanism":"Explicit forks preserve old-client access without pretending new content has a lossless legacy representation.","implementation":"Keep existing document IDs, formats, content, and access intact. Create new-format forks under separate IDs; prohibit in-place migration and automatic link replacement.","check":"After forking and editing, an old client still reads the original document through its previous ID without encountering new-format content.","risk":"Forks can diverge; users must understand they are separate documents."},{"action":"Separate incompatible collaboration sessions","mechanism":"Format-specific sessions prevent new operations from entering a document shared with old clients.","implementation":"Keep legacy sessions on legacy operations. Reject new-format operations there; require an explicit fork. Admit new-format collaborators only after capability checks.","check":"Have old and new clients coedit a legacy document; attempt a new-only operation. Verify rejection and continued old-client reads.","risk":"Cross-format collaboration requires explicit workflow changes, not transparent synchronization."},{"action":"Make rollback stop creation, not erase documents","mechanism":"The rollout flag controls admission; existing-document readers and storage survive flag rollback.","implementation":"On rollback, disable new-format creation and edits, retain new-format read service, and preserve stored content. Return explicit read-only errors for writes.","check":"Create a new document, roll back, reopen with a capable client, and verify unchanged content; writes fail without modifying storage.","risk":"Binary deployment rollback must also retain a compatible reader."},{"action":"Fence writes against rollout races","mechanism":"Commit-time validation prevents requests authorized before rollback from creating documents afterward.","implementation":"Maintain a rollout generation. Atomically validate generation, format permission, and document revision when committing writes; reject stale requests without partial changes.","check":"Pause creation before commit, roll back, then resume. Verify rejection with no published document and no changes to existing documents.","risk":"Every write path, including background jobs, must enforce the fence."},{"action":"Bind capability caches to the requesting client","mechanism":"Session-bound capability declarations prevent one device's newer capabilities from authorizing another device's older binary.","implementation":"Key cached capabilities by client session and declaration generation, not account. Bind authorization tokens accordingly; revalidate mismatches and fail closed for new formats.","check":"Seed an old session with a new client's cached capabilities. Verify cross-session rejection while legacy reads remain available.","risk":"Binding prevents cache confusion, not clients falsely declaring support."},{"action":"Offer an explicit browser reader for new documents","mechanism":"A separately deployed compatible viewer can provide access without changing the installed old binary or down-converting stored content.","implementation":"Provide an authenticated browser URL for new documents. Render their native format with a versioned reader; keep original bytes and legacy document routes unchanged.","check":"Open a shared new document in the browser without upgrading the old binary; verify supported content renders and unauthorized access fails.","risk":"Browser rendering needs security isolation and format-specific fidelity testing."}],"abstention_reason":""}
